maria (sec-eng): Heads-up: analytics wants read access to a subset of SIEM exports for cross-tenant metric work. Asking for a short-lived escrow pattern instead of full export access. Thoughts?

zach (analytics): we need event-level fields (src_ip, user_id hashed, alert_id) for a 90d rolling window to backfill models. no write, read-only.

maria (sec-eng): want to avoid giving raw PII. proposal: masked copy + encrypted envelope that infra can unwrap on JIT with approvals. access logged to audit events.

jonah (sre): curious what "masked copy" means here. is it tokenized? reversible?

zach (analytics): tokenized user_id (deterministic hash with pepper), ips truncated to /24, remove user-agent. we need stable pseudonymous ids for dedupe.

lee (infra): we can do a pipeline step: transform -> store in analytics-bucket encrypted with a separate KMS key (analytics-escrow-key). Access requires KMS:Decrypt + approval ticket. We already have similar for external partners.

dana (compliance): must ensure retention is enforced and that any unwrapping produces an immutable audit record of who requested it, justification, and TTL for the unwrapped snapshot. Also need legal signoff if this touches regulated customer traffic.

maria (sec-eng): agreed. propose: JIT unwrap only allowed to named SRE/analytics roles, via a short-lived signed URL that expires in 15 minutes. every unwrap creates an audit trace in the central audit log with ticket id and reviewer.

jonah (sre): can we automate reviewers? or at least require a two-step approval for >30d requests?

lee (infra): automation ok: if requester is in "analytics-oncall" group and request matches policy (no raw PII fields), auto-approve. otherwise require manual compliance review. enforcement in the KMS proxy layer.

zach (analytics): sounds good. what about copies for experiments? need ability to snapshot for up to 72h for experiments, but must be tied to ticket.

dana (compliance): snapshots <72h are ok with explicit justification and ticket, but must be auto-expired and deleted by the pipeline. retention policy must block manual extensions without SOC/Legal approval.

maria (sec-eng): open questions: 1) which exact fields allowed unwrapped 2) audit retention for the unwrap events (we suggest 7 years for forensic trail) 3) RBAC role names and membership flow 4) emergency bypass for incident response.

jonah (sre): emergency bypass: allow "sec-oncall" role to request ephemeral unwrap with post-hoc justification within 24h. all audits flagged, and a manager must sign off.

lee (infra): technical plan: transform jobs run in VPC, push transformed files to analytics-bucket: s3://redwood-analytics-escrow/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/events.ndjson.gpg. KMS key policy includes an IAM principal for the KMS-proxy role. unwrap flow goes through ksm-proxy service which requires OAuth + ticket header.

maria (sec-eng): security checklist draft: - confirm deterministic hashing algorithm + pepper storage - list of columns redacted/tokenized - KMS key rotation plan - audit log retention and export to SIEM - RBAC naming & onboarding doc - emergency bypass playbook

zach (analytics): i'll draft the required field list and example transform config today: will ping once done.

logbot: policy-bot: created ticket #SEC-8945 for "delegated analytics escrow access" and assigned to dana, lee, maria. due: 2026-04-15.

dana (compliance): added compliance checklist to #SEC-8945, will review the field list once zach posts.

maria (sec-eng): next steps: zach to post transform config + example output, lee to validate KMS policy and proxy changes, dana to review compliance constraints. we'll aim for a pilot with one dataset next sprint. :thumbsup:

zach (analytics): thanks all — i'll post the config in the ticket in a bit. if anyone wants to pair on the transform rules DM me.

maria (sec-eng): tagging @dana and @lee for approval flow signoff.

jonah (sre): FYI, if we need a temporary workspace for unwrapped snapshots, we'll spin up ephemeral infra under analytics-escrow-qa with automatic termination.

maria (sec-eng): perfect. closing thread once SEC-8945 has checklist items green.
